apresentacao.subtitulo: While your ad waits for someone to show up, ProspectX goes to the companies that need your service right now — with phone and email, ready to contact.
apresentacao.ctaObservacao: Works without signing up. You see real companies before deciding.
apresentacao.passo1Titulo: Tell us your trade and where you work
apresentacao.passo1Texto: Stonemason in Austin, sandblasting in Houston, whatever it is. Accepts neighbourhoods too, so leads stay close to you.
apresentacao.passo2Titulo: Get the companies that hire you
apresentacao.passo2Texto: Not a list of competitors. The system knows a stonemason sells to builders and architects — and that's what it looks for.
apresentacao.passo3Texto: WhatsApp with the message ready, one click per company. Or email up to 50 at once, with your portfolio attached.
apresentacao.contaTitulo: Do the math before you look at the price
apresentacao.contaTexto: What is a new client worth to you? If one job closes at $4,000 and ProspectX costs $37 a month, closing a single one per month already paid for the tool 100 times over.
apresentacao.contaRodape: That's why the trial is 7 days, no strings: enough time to find out whether it closes.
apresentacao.difEsperarTexto: You pay to be visible and hope someone searches at exactly the right moment.
apresentacao.difIrTexto: You pick the trade and the area, and get companies with contact details. The direction is reversed.
apresentacao.planosTitulo: Founder pricing for the first ones in
apresentacao.planosTexto: The first spots lock the price for life. After that, standard pricing applies.

faq.p1: How does the free trial work?
faq.r1: You add your card and get 7 days to use the tool at no charge. If you don't cancel before the period ends, the first charge happens automatically. You can cancel at any time, in one click, from your profile area, and get back anything already paid — no deductions and no need to explain.
faq.r2: Each search uses credits based on how many companies it returns: up to 10 companies costs 10 credits, up to 20 costs 18, up to 30 costs 25, and up to 40 costs 30. Your plan tops up the balance each cycle (100 to 150 credits, depending on the plan) and credits do NOT expire: whatever you don't use stays in the account and adds to the next top-up. Use 50 of 100 in a month and you start the next month with 150.
faq.p3: Can I cancel whenever I want?
faq.r3: Yes. Cancelling takes a single click, from your profile area, with no need to give a reason. Once cancelled, you're not charged again.
faq.r4: Yes. The search queries OpenStreetMap, a public collaborative database of businesses, and returns name, address and — where the company published it — phone, email and website. Coverage varies by city: in some areas most records have a phone number, in others fewer. When we find nothing real for the area and trade you asked for, we say so on screen instead of inventing results.
faq.p5: How do I send my portfolio to the leads I find?
faq.r5: After subscribing, upload your portfolio or proposal under 'My profile'. Every company in your search results has a 'Send flyer' button that opens WhatsApp with a ready-made message and a link to your most recent file.
faq.r6: Yes. The card number and security code are processed directly by the payment provider, inside your browser — they never reach our servers.
